title.narrative: Start Fund-Assistance aux victimes d'inondation à Tahoua

description.narrative: C’est un projet d’assistance d’urgence aux victimes d’inonondation dans la région de Tahoua qui sera mis en oeuvre par un consortium des ONG internationales WHH comme lead, Mercy Corps et CWW . Le projet assistera 1000 ménages victimes d'inondation en cash inconditionnel, Kits NFI/ dignité, kits Abrits et education nutritionnelle pendant une période de 45 jours

The flood affected population urgently need support in other to survive the crisis because they had to flee their families living behind them all their belongings. The distribution of unconditional cash will allow them to get access to basic necessities as well as food. The distribution of Shelter NFI kits will allow Households to get access to items for cooking and protection against hazard. The Nutrition support activities, complementing Cash Transfer interventions will also involve the distribution of supplementary fortified flour to Pregnant and Lactating Women (PLW) as well as children aged 6 to 23 months . The nutritional education will help them to know and consume food of more nutritional value and to avoid the struggle against malnutrition of children under 5 years old.
